notes.title: Ladies I’m Ready v1.1.31125 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Hello, fellow student of UOH, we hope you are enjoying your first week of “school”![/b]

Today, we are bringing the first campus maintenance to improve your life on campus!

[b]“Roadblocks Removed”[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed “Legendary Trophy” achievement couldn’t be unlocked (after updating, simply play a scene, and the achievement should be unlocked if you have all the rest unlocked)
[*] Fixed achievements not synced on Steam and in-game if in-game achievement was already unlocked prior
[*] Fixed some typos
[/list]

[b]“Campus Life Improvements”[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now skip texting if you have already texted before
[/list]

That’s it for now! Thanks for choosing UOH. If you want to stay up to date with the latest events and news, please join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/pEQreFcUa5]Discord[/url][/b]!

Make sure to follow Midou Studio on [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@Midou_Studio]Youtube[/url][/b], [b][url=https://x.com/Midou_studio]X[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/midou.studio/]Instagram[/url][/b] as well!
